values.name: Feedback
values.definition: To be open to positive and constructive feedback from supervisors, co-workers, volunteer, and general public in an effort to take advantage of all opportunities to grow and improve.

values.name: Best Practices
values.definition: To continually strive to explore best practices and ways to improve our programs, policies, procedures and organization effectiveness.

values.name: Positive Attitude
values.definition: To maintain a solution oriented, optimistic outlook on our ability to make a difference.

values.name: Solution-driven
values.definition: To strive for creative solutions to any challenges that we may face.

values.name: Responsibility
values.definition: To agree that it is everyone’s responsibility to create a positive experience for volunteers, guardian surrenders, donors, adopters and the general public whether or not what they need is in our job description.

values.name: Professional
values.definition: To hold ourselves to the utmost standards of professionalism in appearance and attitude at all times.

values.name: Volunteer and Donor Appreciation
values.definition: To express our sincere appreciation for our volunteers and donors in every interaction.
